To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The incorporation of CNTs and/or graphene in ceramic matrices is an effective way to improve the mechanical properties and fracture toughness of ceramics.
the addition of 1% of graphene to the Al2O3 matrix increases the flexural strength by 30%, and the addition of 0.1% of MWCNT to the same matrix increases the flexure strength by 20%.
the addition of carbon nanotubes and graphene to ceramic matrices can significantly enhance the mechanical properties of the resulting composites.

the design, synthesis and characterisation of ceramic/CNT nanocomposite materials with enhanced properties.
the development of new materials and their application to the solution of problems in engineering and science.
the development of new ceramic materials and their composites with carbon nanostructures for applications in structural and functional materials.

, although the ceramics/CNTs and ceramics/graphene nanocomposites are still in a nascent state, they have shown great promise in terms of improved mechanical properties and enhanced thermal and electrical conductivities, and thus are very promising materials for future high-tech applications.

the ceramic/CNT and graphene nanocomposites have shown great potential in improving the properties and performance of ceramics.

the ceramic nanocomposites reinforced by the CNTs or graphene are promising for a range of applications, such as in aerospace, automotive, electronics, biomedical and energy industries.
